# Source Action Ownership Delta

The Awtsmoos gives one shared doorway many callers, so safety need not be copied from view to view;
Awtsmoos.com keeps exact-source actions in one vessel, with new-tab protection remaining true.

## Evidence

- `tanachView.js` imports `appendSourceActions` from `resultSourceActions.js`.
- Tanach result cards delegate their result actions to that shared helper.
- `resultSourceActions.js` sets `link.target = '_blank'` only for the new-tab action.
- The same shared helper sets `link.rel = 'noopener noreferrer'`.
- Its current new-tab visible text is `New tab ↗`; `Open exact verse` is no longer the owning UI label.
- Production files are both below 120 lines and are not currently modified by this pass.

## Delta

The mode test still searches `tanachView.js` itself for raw new-tab attributes and an obsolete label. This is stale ownership coupling.

## Exact Rewrite

Rewrite only `searchMode.test.mjs` completely:
- keep deliberate Library-mode behavior assertions;
- keep URL explicit-mode assertions;
- keep Tanach API `exact: 'true'` assertion;
- assert `tanachView.js` imports and invokes `appendSourceActions`;
- assert `resultSourceActions.js` owns `_blank`, `noopener noreferrer`, and the current `New tab` action;
- keep the test below 120 lines.

## NEXT_ACTION

Rewrite the test, reread it, run the direct mode test and then the complete Sefarim suite fail-fast.
